name: hypes
description: Give the assistant a private, revisable relationship model of the user.

interface.shortDescription: A revisable relationship model of the user
interface.longDescription: Hypes gives the assistant a private, revisable relationship model of the user. It can quietly refine reusable relationships as conversations change the assistant's understanding, without treating them as user-approved facts. The user's current message always takes priority, and Hypes does not store raw conversations, direct identifiers, sensitive traits, Sense guidance, or Corpus source-linked context.
